title: Edmund and the Bakery
author: August Galloway
blurb: Dominic Okonkwo, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
